description: Use when the user asks why a brand logo does not show in inboxes, or about BIMI. Returns the BIMI record, logo and certificate URLs and whether DMARC is enforced as BIMI requires. The logo is not downloaded. Ex: 'Is BIMI set up for example.com?'. Free trial without an API key: a few calls a day.

domain.description: A public domain name, e.g. example.com.

name: bimi
title: BIMI record check
